availability_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available on request from the INGV.
exact_file_to_request: Numerical layered Vp and Vs (or depth-dependent Vp/Vs) underlying Calo--Tramelli 2018 supplementary Figure S1.2a/b, including layer-top depths, interpolation-node version, units, depth datum, and confirmation of the version passed to Tan et al. GaMMA-1D. The 2018 supplement says Vp/Vs was updated using depth-dependent Wadati diagrams, so a constant-ratio routine model is not an exact substitute.
request_from: INGV--Osservatorio Vesuviano / Anna Tramelli; corresponding author Marco Calo, calo@igeofisica.unam.mx, may identify the 2018 table. Nobody was contacted.

searches.result: Readable article; no numerical layer table; data available on request from INGV.
Readable 14-page supplement. Section 2 and Figure S1.2 describe layered and interpolated profiles graphically; no numerical Vp/Vs table. No digitization.
Official INGV repository REST inventory: ORIGINAL bundle contains only Calo_2018.pdf, 13,415,524 bytes. Other bundles are thumbnail, extracted text and license; no model dataset.
Tree/README inspected. Released 1d_vmod_velest.mod is the Tan-fitted model and excluded. Fixed 3d_vmod and weights are permitted method artifacts, not proof of the exact association profile.
Cited Priolo et al. blind-test model has numerical lithological-unit properties, but it is a synthetic 3D test, not the Calo--Tramelli 1D starting model; not substituted.
Citing dataset lists catalog, displacement and precipitation files, not a numerical velocity profile; derived seismic catalog excluded.
Tramelli et al. 2021 Table 1 gives five layer-top depths and Vp values plus Vp/Vs=1.78. Verified and used only as labeled published alternative.

Nardone et al. 2020 Table 2 provides a different local near-surface inversion, four layers over a half-space, not the 2018 layered association profile. Cites Calo--Tramelli but does not reproduce that table. Not substituted.
Citing 2025 tomography study identified in search; direct text retrieval encountered reCAPTCHA. No derived source-data model was downloaded or substituted.

rejected_numeric_candidate.reason: Different local shallow inversion, not the requested association starting profile. Not used.
